title: Audio asset validation
responsibility: Checks supported audio content and derives a content-addressed filename and metadata.

inputs.name: audioAsset.bytes
inputs.description: Nonempty audio bytes, limited to 50,000,000 bytes.

inputs.name: audioAsset.filename
inputs.description: Original filename whose lowercase extension selects the format.

outputs.name: audioAsset
outputs.description: SHA-256 filename with the original lowercase extension, audio MIME type and media kind, plus WAV metadata when applicable. MP3, Ogg and M4A undergo header/container checks; no file is written.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects empty/oversized data, unsupported formats and content that fails the selected format check. WAV parser failures propagate.
